status: Consumer migration required by M2 Phase A.

extraChanges.change: The PDF CLI uses OfficeConverter for native and registered routes, atomic publication, bounded output and shared diagnostics. Removed the superseded per-format dispatcher, host commit helper and fixed-layout dispatcher. CLI selection, loss switches and publication flags remain on the existing parser.
extraChanges.reason: File conversion and publication have one library owner. Two tests solely pinning the removed host commit helper were removed; public command and shared publication behavior remain covered.

extraChanges.change: Sheet listing uses the public Excel reader and its SheetNames property.
extraChanges.reason: The static helper is internal engine plumbing after lifecycle consolidation.

extraChanges.change: Saved job, report and batch command tests use OfficeBatchOptions/OfficeBatchReport and the canonical v2 JSON contract. Removed the duplicate host-retention test now owned by OfficeIMO.Tests.
extraChanges.reason: The command surface serializes shared library reports and no longer owns a separate collector contract.

extraChanges.note: The tabular CSV-to-XLSX route uses CreateWriter(...).WriteTable(...) with the existing header policy, cancellation, streaming reader and atomic output commit.

extraChanges.old: Consumer batch fixtures expect source.txt.pdf rather than the adopted source.pdf output basename.
extraChanges.new: Use source.pdf in saved-job, publication, recovery, history and CLI output assertions.
extraChanges.reason: The extension-replacement naming rule applies to every batch consumer; source inputs and all output integrity assertions remain unchanged.

extraChanges.old: Remaining consumer fixtures depend on appended diagram/iWork output extensions or unrelated body-text snapping/dense line geometry.
extraChanges.new: Expect drawing.pdf/layers.pdf/source.xlsx; keep group-move text outside horizontal snap guides and use explicit disjoint-line leading in selection fixtures.
extraChanges.reason: Preserve publication/checkpoint assertions, original group translation tolerance, exact group offset/undo and strict interline gap assertions under current defaults. No production behavior or typography default is changed.

applicationStatus: Phase A applied and validated on the supported macOS targets. Phase B and Tier 2 entries retain their status; Windows .NET Framework validation remains pending.
authority: Docs/officeimo.api-design.md, including the c526a10ad2 framework decision; the approved design overrides M0 open questions.

questionResolutions.conversionForms: Source.ToTarget, source.SaveAsTarget and OfficeConversionReport; async ToTarget returns OfficeConversionResult<T>. ToHtml returns string. No static From factories.
questionResolutions.frameworks: No framework is dropped in 3.6. Original library TFMs and Windows net472 conditions remain; the front door and both Workflows projects support the full set. Modern-only engines stay conditional.
questionResolutions.packageDirection: Word.Pdf and PowerPoint.Pdf export native documents. Reverse reconstruction is Pdf.Word and Pdf.PowerPoint; Excel reconstruction is Pdf.Excel. Word page images live in Word.Pdf.
questionResolutions.surface: Markdown syntax nodes are exempt from the format prefix. OfficeColor/OfficeColorRole use the root OfficeIMO namespace. Authoring, units, image-builder consolidation, visibility baselines and AOT smoke acceptance are Phase B.
